- **Snapshot-only values:** `macds`, `macdh`, `boll_ub` and `boll_lb` come only from the snapshot. I did not retrieve them as separate indicator series, so I have no history for them.

## 2. Indicators selected (8) and why

| Indicator | Role |

| close_10_ema | Short-term momentum and fast trend filter |
| close_50_sma | Medium-term trend and dynamic resistance |
| close_200_sma | Long-term trend benchmark |

| boll (with boll_ub and boll_lb from the snapshot) | Volatility envelope and mean reference |
| atr | Volatility for stop and position sizing |
| vwma | Volume-weighted trend confirmation |

These cover trend (3 moving averages), momentum (MACD, RSI), volatility (Bollinger, ATR) and volume (VWMA), with little overlap.

## 3. Price context (from the OHLCV data)

- **Prior structure:** ETH-USD fell from 2369.04 (2026-05-10) to a 1506.51 intraday low on 2026-06-06. It then ranged roughly 1,800–1,950 through July and mid-August.
- **Breakout:** On 2026-08-19, price jumped from 1916.46 to 2251.46 on about 29.6B volume. It peaked near the 2805.50 high on 2026-09-21.
- **Recent decline:** Price held roughly 2,670–2,730 into early October, then dropped from 2697.52 (10-06) to 2471.91 (10-08).
- **Lower highs:** Since then, closing rallies have topped out at 2534.70 (10-11), 2496.63 (10-13), 2470.77 (10-21) and 2422.31 (11-04). The 11-04 spike (intraday high 2446.05) fully reversed the next day, to 2234.48 on 11-05, with an intraday low of 2203.81.
- **Latest leg down:** Closes of 2120.98 (11-08), 2131.50 (11-09) and 2056.29 (11-10) make a fresh multi-week low. The 11-10 intraday low was 2009.96.

## 4. Indicator readings

**Trend (moving averages)**
- **Price vs. averages:** The 2056.29 close is below every trend reference:

| Reference | Value | Price relative to it |
|---|---|---|
| 10 EMA | 2198.01 | below by about 142 |
| 200 SMA | 2152.21 | below by about 96 |
| Bollinger mid (20 SMA) | 2272.68 | below |
| VWMA | 2243.79 (indicator tool) | below |
| 50 SMA | 2456.32 | below by about 400 |

- **10 EMA:** It has fallen every day in the window, from 2578.78 (10-11) to 2198.01. That is persistent short-term downward momentum.
- **50 SMA:** It is also declining steadily, from 2556.17 (10-11) to 2456.32. It is still well above the 200 SMA, so there is **no death cross** yet. The gap is about 304 and narrowing.
- **200 SMA:** It is nearly flat at about 2,152 (2133.87 to 2159.11 over the window). The closes on 11-08, 11-09 and 11-10 are below it, the first such closes inside the retrieved 30-day window. The first of them was 2120.98 against a 200 SMA of 2154.51. A clean break below the long-term benchmark is a meaningful deterioration, but three closes are not a confirmed regime change.

**Momentum**
- **MACD:** The line is **-83.34** against a signal of **-68.34**, so the histogram is **-15.00**. The MACD line was only -2.07 on 10-11 and has trended down since. It is at the low end of the window and below its signal line. Momentum is bearish and has not yet turned. I have no histogram series, so I can't say whether the -15.00 histogram is widening or narrowing.
- **RSI:** It is **30.21**, right at the conventional 30 threshold, not clearly below it. In the retrieved window it dipped to 30.29 (10-30) and 30.83 (10-29), also close to 30, then recovered to the 39–54 range. The one outlier was 54.08 on the 11-04 spike. RSI is near oversold, but oversold readings can persist in a downtrend. A bounce is plausible, but RSI alone doesn't confirm a reversal. I see no bullish divergence in this window: price made a new low and RSI sits at about the same level as the 10-30 reading, while price on 10-30 was about 2241.

**Volatility**
- **Bollinger Bands:** The middle band is 2272.68, the upper band 2461.39 and the lower band **2083.98**. The 2056.29 close is **below the lower band**, and the 11-10 intraday low of 2009.96 is further below. The middle band has dropped from 2650.60 (10-11) to 2272.68, so the whole envelope has shifted down. Closing below the lower band shows strong downside pressure. In trends, price can "walk the band", so it is not a standalone buy signal. A close back above 2083.98 would be an early sign the move is easing.
- **ATR:** It is **96.00**, about 4.7% of price (simple arithmetic: 96.00 / 2056.29). It is elevated relative to the early-November low of 78.86 (11-03), though similar to mid-October (about 91–95). One-day ranges of 100+ points are normal here.

**Volume**
- **VWMA:** At 2243.79 it sits above the 10 EMA (2198.01) but below the 20 SMA (2272.68), and has fallen from 2637.14 (10-11). Volume-weighted price is falling alongside simple price, so the decline is not a thin-volume artifact.
- **Selling volume:** The latest bar's volume of about 13.6B is moderate. It is below the 11-05 reversal day (about 18.7B) and the 10-29 and 10-30 sell-off days (about 18.8B and 20.0B). I have no basis to call it capitulation volume.

## 5. Synthesis

**Bias: bearish, with short-term oversold conditions.** The trend and momentum indicators agree on the downside. Price is below the 10 EMA, 20 SMA, 50 SMA, VWMA and now the 200 SMA. The MACD line is below its signal and well below zero. The 10 EMA, 50 SMA and Bollinger mid are all falling. The 11-04 spike and failure to hold it shows sellers defending the 2,420–2,450 area.

**Counterpoints:**
- RSI at about 30 and a close below the lower Bollinger band raise the chance of a relief bounce.
- The 200 SMA is flat rather than falling, and the 50/200 gap is still positive.
- The 11-10 bar may not be final.

**Reference levels (from tool outputs only, not tested supports or resistances):**
- **Overhead:**
  - 2083.98 (lower Bollinger band, first reclaim test)

  - 2198.01 (10 EMA)
  - 2243.79 (VWMA)
  - 2272.68 (20 SMA)

  - 2456.32 (50 SMA)
- **Downside:** The 11-10 intraday low of 2009.96. Below it, the chart shows July–August trading between about 1,820 and 1,950, and the June low of 1506.51. These are prior price ranges, not verified supports. I make no claim that they will hold.

**Scenarios:**
- **Bearish continuation:** Closes that stay below the 200 SMA and the lower band, with MACD falling further, favour tests of the 2009.96 low and the 1,800s range.
- **Relief bounce:** Closes back above 2083.98 and then the 2152–2198 cluster (200 SMA and 10 EMA) would signal stabilisation. Even then, the 10 EMA, 20 SMA and 50 SMA are all above price and sloping down, so rallies into 2,200–2,460 face layered resistance.
- **Risk sizing:** With ATR at about 96, a 1× ATR move is about 96 points and 2× is about 192. For example, a stop 2× ATR above 2056.29 would be near 2248, which is roughly the VWMA and 20 SMA zone. This is arithmetic for illustration, not a recommendation.

**Not supported by the data:**
- No death cross exists yet.
- There is no confirmed bullish divergence.
- There are no verified historical bounces at any level I've named.
